definitions.explanation: A person who takes in and cares for a child who is not their own, either through a formal foster care system or informally. Also used for pet adoption.

examples.japanese: {里親|さとおや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We are looking for foster parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{里親|さとおや}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: She raised three children as a foster parent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{里親|さとおや}になって⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}しています→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: We are looking for someone to adopt a rescued cat.

notes:
Literally 'village parent' — historically, children were sometimes sent to live with families in other villages. Today the term is used in both formal child welfare contexts and very commonly for pet adoption.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {里親|さとおや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a foster parent / to adopt (a pet)
- {里親|さとおや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to recruit foster parents / adopters
- {里親|さとおや}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: foster care system
- {里親|さとおや}⟦{探|さが}し→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: looking for an adopter (especially for pets)

PET ADOPTION:
In modern Japanese, {里親|さとおや} is extremely commonly used for finding homes for rescued or unwanted animals. {里親|さとおや}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧ (looking for adopters) is a standard phrase on pet adoption websites.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{養親|ようしん}→養親：16814_youshin⟧: adoptive parent — legal adoption (more formal)
- {里子|さとご}: foster child
- ⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧: adopted child — formal legal adoption
